intent: Increased body width and wheel track for improved stability.
learning: Expect to see a reduction in line loss events and rms error in the next telemetry report.
rationale: The telemetry from the last race indicated that the robot struggled with stability, as evidenced by a high number of line loss events (5 out of 8) and a significant rms error of 0.2. To improve stability and control, I have decided to increase the body width to 0.16m (from 0.14m) and adjust the wheel track to 0.15m (from 0.12m). These changes should enhance the robot's balance and reduce line loss events, leading to better performance in future races.
